summary.short: Federal reconciliation act whose AI provisions fund federal AI and IT modernization, Medicare AI payment-integrity tools, defense and border AI, and bar States from enforcing AI regulation for 10 years from enactment.
summary.long: The AI-related provisions sit mainly among appropriations. Section 43201 appropriates $500,000,000 to Commerce, available to 30 September 2034, for federal IT modernization with commercial AI and automation. For 10 years from enactment, States and political subdivisions may not enforce laws limiting AI models, AI systems or automated decision systems in interstate commerce, except listed exceptions. Section 112204 adds SSA section 1899D, requiring AI tools against Medicare improper payments by 1 January 2027 and a report to Congress by 1 January 2029. Defense sections 20002, 20005, 20006 and 20008 appropriate funds for AI uses, including naval shipbuilding autonomy and Cyber Command. Section 50404 directs DOE to curate scientific data for AI and develop science models, with $150,000,000 through FY2026. Sections 60003 and 90004 fund CBP AI-enabled inspection and restrict surveillance tower funds to autonomous capabilities tested and accepted. Section 71401 creates a $10 billion-per-year rural health program for FY2026-2030 whose allotments may fund AI technology adoption. Other sections are not AI-specific.

notes: Excerpt: the document reproduces selected One Big Beautiful Bill Act 2025 sections (AGORA-labelled), not the whole act; only provisions in the excerpt are covered. The registry's reference to H. Con. Res. 14 does not appear in the text, so no legal_basis row is recorded. Sections 20002, 20004, 20005 and 20006 each appear twice with different amounts (AGORA 2529/2560, 2530/2561, 2531/2562, 2533/2563); the versions are not reconciled here. Sec. 43201(c) (a 10-year bar on state enforcement of certain AI laws) is outside this partial fill. 'Secretary' in new SSA sec. 1899D is not defined in the excerpt. US Code cross-references inside sections are recorded at title or act level only.
